name: Hanamaru Anne
source:
The seventh sister.

Speaks using the Kansai dialect. She always wears no bra. She grew up in a space full of women, so she has a bit of a lesbian streak going on, hating men may play a role in that. She detests the protagonist because of his sex.

She is not good with stories of the occult, but loves to talk about it a lot. She's had a sixth sense for it even since she was a child.

She is fond of saying "Let's eat a banana".

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/ane&boin/chara/anne.htm]official site[/url]]
